initial_search_constraints.dynamic_action_operands: seeded macro/subtree patterns preferred; blind mutation may keep operands constant initially
initial_search_constraints.dynamic_feature_indices: selected typed BB-index patterns may be enabled without opening arbitrary expression graphs
initial_search_constraints.subtree_ports: available to seeded/hand-designed reusable macros; expansion occurs before runtime

notes: VM expressiveness is deliberately broader than the initial blind search grammar.
Subtree ports compile away into concrete blackboard/value references and are not runtime calls.
Action opcodes remain compile-time constants even when unit/item/quantity operands are dynamic.
Dynamic legal-feature indices are restricted to CONST or blackboard sources to keep CUDA execution bounded and non-recursive.
